title: Staff
intro: Everyone who signs in to your organization, and the role that decides what each of them may do.
empty: Nobody else is here yet. Add the people who work with you.

create.title: Add staff
create.description: Give them an email, a username or both. Staff without email sign in with your organization code and their username.
create.name: Full name
create.emailHint: Optional. They can sign in with it and reset their own password.
create.usernameHint: Optional. 2-32 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.
create.phoneHint: Optional. Only for your own records and exports: it is not a sign-in name.
create.temporaryPasswordHint: They choose their own password the first time they sign in.
create.handover: Give {name} these details to sign in:
create.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.

form.usernameInvalid: Use 2-32 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.
form.emailOrUsername: Give an email, a username or both.

changeRole.title: Change {name}'s role
changeRole.description: The new role applies from their next action.

changePhone.title: Change {name}'s phone
changePhone.description: Leave it empty to remove the number. It is not a sign-in name, and the audit log never keeps it.
changePhone.label: Phone

problems.required: Use a phone number like 98765 43210, or leave it empty.
problems.invalid: Use a phone number like 98765 43210, or leave it empty.

resetPassword.title: Reset {name}'s password
resetPassword.description: They are signed out everywhere and must choose a new password with this temporary one.

remove.title: Remove {name}?
remove.description: They are signed out at once and can't sign in again. What they did stays in your records.
